summary: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_islandhop_backend.py (27 cases) after main agent's iteration-1 fixes. RESULT: 25/27 PASS (92.6%), up from 21/27 (78%). All 6 originally critical ObjectId/_id 500 failures are NOW FIXED and return 200. The /api/auth/me duplicate-route fix is verified (full User object returned, email matches). Scheduled-Order + Recurring-Order suite continues to pass 100% (8/8) after auth-helper edits. Two NEW failures surfaced — both pre-existing bugs NOT in this iteration's scope (PUT /addresses lets client overwrite user_id which breaks subsequent ownership checks; GET /promo-codes/{code}/validate has naive-vs-aware datetime comparison that was already called out in iteration_1 critical_code_review_comments #6).

minor.issue: Handler does NOT override address.user_id from request body before $set (compare to POST /addresses line 1828 which DOES). Result: any field, including user_id, is overwritten by client input. In the test, the previous test agent passed user_id='ignored-server-overrides' which is then persisted, and the subsequent POST /addresses/{id}/set-default ownership check (line 1896) returns 404. SECURITY: an authenticated user can also write user_id of someone else into their address doc. Fix: add `address.user_id = current_user.id` immediately after the ownership check at server.py:1857. PRE-EXISTING bug; not introduced by the iteration-2 fixes.

500 — `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes` at server.py:1741. `now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)` is aware, but `datetime.fromisoformat(promo['valid_from'].replace('Z','+00:00'))` returns NAIVE when the stored value has no offset (which is what create_promo_code stores when client posts `datetime.utcnow().isoformat()` — no Z, no offset). Fix options: (a) normalise stored dates to UTC ISO with offset at create time, (b) replace tzinfo if missing: `if vf.tzinfo is None: vf = vf.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`. PRE-EXISTING bug — already flagged in iteration_1 critical_code_review_comments #6.

retested_and_now_passing: GET /api/auth/me — returns full User object incl. email (duplicate session-cookie variant removed)

action_items: Patch PUT /api/addresses/{address_id} (server.py:1850) to set `address.user_id = current_user.id` after ownership check — prevents ownership hijack and unblocks the set-default test.

Patch GET /api/promo-codes/{code}/validate (server.py:1738-1741) to normalise parsed datetimes to UTC-aware (e.g. `if vf.tzinfo is None: vf = vf.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`), OR store dates already with UTC offset in create_promo_code.
(Backlog from iteration_1, still open) Authenticate POST /api/promo-codes/{code}/apply via Bearer token; migrate POST /api/drivers/{id}/location to JSON body; resolve admin gating docs.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT handlers across the codebase should never trust `user_id`/`owner_id` from the request body — always override from the authenticated user. Audit other PUT endpoints (orders, support tickets, payments) for the same shape.
Datetime handling is mixed: prepare_for_mongo stores ISO strings, validate parses with fromisoformat+replace('Z'). Standardise on UTC-aware datetimes end-to-end OR always coerce on read.
server.py is still ~4165 lines after route removals — long-term split into routers/modules (auth, addresses, promo_codes, support, scheduled_orders, drivers, vendors, analytics).
test_credentials: Tests register fresh users per run with unique emails like sched_test_<timestamp>_<uuid>@test.com / Test1234!.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates 3 throwaway users (customer/restaurant/driver), a few scheduled/recurring orders, an address, a promo code, and a support ticket. No persistent fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 retest confirms all 6 ObjectId/_id fixes and both duplicate-route removals are effective. Remaining 2 failures are pre-existing bugs unrelated to the iteration-2 scope. If main agent applies the two listed patches, re-running /app/backend/tests/test_islandhop_backend.py should yield 27/27. Tests use BASE_URL=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env and JWT Bearer auth only.
rca of the issue: Both new failures are unrelated to iteration-2 fixes. (1) PUT /api/addresses overwrites server-controlled fields with client input because the handler does not re-assign user_id after ownership check (POST does — copy that pattern). (2) Promo-code validate compares datetime.now(timezone.utc) (aware) with fromisoformat-parsed valid_from (naive when no offset stored), raising TypeError; either always store offset-aware ISO or coerce to UTC on read.
